text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, yes!
That was a truly great race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else's fighting spirit
was truly incredible, too...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "I was so fired up thinking, 'Like I'm gonna lose!'—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
With a full-power muscle dash,
I managed to place somehow!

text_block_list.text: I'm so happy to hear you say that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Because it means I was able to run in a way
that's true to myself, hehe..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'll train even harder
and take 1st place next time--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yes! Just like you said, Trainer, I need to become tougher and more resilient...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that that's settled,
we're pumping up our muscles with the bench press!!
